QUOTE: **A compiler barrier.** `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` hides the value from the optimiser. With inline asm it is an empty `asm volatile` with `"+r"` on `x`. Otherwise it XORs with `mbedtls_ct_zero`, which is declared `volatile` in `constant_time.c`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the compiler barrier hiding values from the optimiser and places the primitives in library/constant_time_impl.h.
